scope: Selected source-backed capabilities; not an exhaustive feature inventory of whole upstream products

gaps.title: Record execution when it happens, not after the answer
gaps.observed_state: Partial in uncommitted #241 work: AgentTraceService explicitly groups stages after execution; all spans are root-linked, without real start/end timing.
gaps.php_implementation: Instrument actual PHP boundaries with begin/end span IDs, parent IDs, monotonic durations and observed wall times. Keep trace/event records inside the same conversation JSON; do not invent causal order.
gaps.acceptance_test: A two-tool, two-provider-attempt fixture reconstructs actual ordering and nesting; a timed-out tool has an ended error span.

gaps.title: Recover incomplete turns and distinguish committed from delivered work
gaps.observed_state: Current file writes are atomic, but a full turn is appended only after answer construction. There is no canonical per-step sequence or crash-resume contract.
gaps.php_implementation: Store request ID, turn state, monotonic event sequence and terminal outcome in the same JSON. Persist started/failed/completed milestones so an interrupted turn is not silently absent.
gaps.acceptance_test: Kill a disposable worker between retrieval and response; recovery shows an interrupted turn, never a falsely completed one.

gaps.title: Prevent duplicate tickets and actions when a chat request is retried
gaps.observed_state: SupportTicketService::create uses a new random ID for every creation. Transcript persistence happens after potential escalation; a subsequent save error returns a retry message.
gaps.php_implementation: Introduce a client request/idempotency key tied to actor and conversation, record the action receipt, and return the existing ticket on replay. Do not confuse failure to save an audit with failure to create a ticket.
gaps.acceptance_test: Repeat one HTTP request after a simulated post-ticket disk failure: exactly one ticket exists and the returned receipt matches it.

gaps.title: Validate conversation ownership before model/tool execution
gaps.observed_state: Support derives user data safely, but the supplied conversation ID is checked at append time, after answer/tool work. This can waste paid calls or cause side effects before rejecting the chat ID.
gaps.php_implementation: Resolve and authorize the actor-owned chat at request ingress before provider calls or ticket actions; retain the append-time check for races.
gaps.acceptance_test: A different guest/customer/admin conversation ID is rejected with zero model calls and zero new tickets.

gaps.title: Make multi-turn understanding match the History interface
gaps.observed_state: Draft History reopens messages, but Support modelReply builds its prompt from the current question/context; Enterprise mainly retains one verified report period.
gaps.php_implementation: Load a bounded, actor-owned sequence of prior turns and verified tool facts into the model request. Use explicit token/byte budgets and preserve source scope across ambiguous pronouns.
gaps.acceptance_test: After “show Ayyappa products”, “what is the second one made of?” refers to the verified second item; a new chat has no inherited context.

gaps.title: Capture replayable source and instruction provenance
gaps.observed_state: Uncommitted traces include selected filters, source name and result count; they do not fully bind response claims to source revisions, result digests, prompt hash and tool-code revision.
gaps.php_implementation: Record sanitized source identifiers/version or fetch time, approved aggregate facts, prompt/tool version hashes and evidence references used by the answer. Exclude private raw rows and hidden reasoning.
gaps.acceptance_test: Change catalogue/report data after a reply: the recorded evidence still explains the original answer and marks stale context.

gaps.title: Measure provider usage and enforce a turn budget
gaps.observed_state: AiClient records HTTP/transport timing and bounds calls, but no response token-usage extraction was found; a max-token request parameter is not observed usage.
gaps.php_implementation: Extract supported input/output/cache usage with explicit unavailable values when absent; aggregate once per model call, cap retries/latency/tokens, and avoid counting root and child usage twice.
gaps.acceptance_test: Fixtures for provider usage present, absent, retry and fallback return correct totals without converting unknown usage to zero.

gaps.title: Expand deterministic fixtures into comparable answer-quality experiments
gaps.observed_state: The local unfinished suite has 10 deterministic helper cases and a baseline; it does not measure arbitrary answer faithfulness, full orchestration, multilingual cases or repeated model variability.
gaps.php_implementation: Keep free deterministic gates; add sanitized expected source IDs/amounts/actions, end-to-end transcript fixtures, adversarial and Tamil cases, code/prompt/model/fixture versions and per-case before/after comparisons.
gaps.acceptance_test: An unrelated-product answer and a plausible but wrong GST total fail their exact evidence checks even when the answer is nonempty and secret-free.

gaps.title: Separate audit failure, customer action success and telemetry delivery
gaps.observed_state: AuditLogService already catches DB write failures, which is good; it still returns an event labeled recorded, and the chat controller can report a generic failure after a ticket was created.
gaps.php_implementation: Represent delivery/commit states explicitly and preserve action receipts. For optional analytics, use safe local buffering/retry only if needed; never let derived metrics retry business actions.
gaps.acceptance_test: Reject audit DB writes: successful business operations remain successful, the audit loss is visible, and reprocessing cannot duplicate events/actions.

gaps.title: Scale and govern private JSON history without changing its storage contract
gaps.observed_state: One JSON file per chat, private paths and locking exist in draft; listings scan files, all writes share one lock, and transcript retention/export-access lifecycle is not implemented.
gaps.php_implementation: Preserve one canonical JSON per chat. Add bounded paging, safe retention/deletion and export audit, backup/restore checks and measured contention handling. Do not introduce a conversation SQL table.
gaps.acceptance_test: Large history paging stays bounded; unauthorized export is denied; a deployment/restore preserves ownership and all committed turns.

gaps.title: Link handoff tickets back to the actual conversation
gaps.observed_state: A chat turn can hold ticket_id, but the support ticket stores generic context rather than an authoritative conversation/turn link and handoff summary.
gaps.php_implementation: Add actor-safe conversation/turn references and a verified handoff summary to the business ticket, with a restricted link for staff to read the matching JSON.
gaps.acceptance_test: Human support opens one ticket and sees the relevant prior question, verified facts and handoff reason without another customer’s data.

gaps.title: Add assignment, priority, pending and snoozed work queues
gaps.observed_state: Support tickets currently use open/answered/closed and reply text; no assignee/team, priority, pending reason or snooze workflow was found.
gaps.php_implementation: Introduce a small PHP ticket state machine and explicit staff ownership, priority and due/snooze fields. Add only the queue features needed by the customer; no Rails migration.
gaps.acceptance_test: Two staff members cannot unintentionally both own a ticket; a waiting-on-customer case is distinguishable from an unanswered urgent case.

gaps.title: Measure first response, handoff, resolution and reopen separately
gaps.observed_state: Operational model latency is present; created_at/updated_at and a current status do not preserve first human response, time waiting, time to handoff or reopen episodes.
gaps.php_implementation: Record explicit ticket transitions and timestamps, distinguish bot from human replies, and compute date-window metrics from those events. Do not use updated_at as every lifecycle timestamp.
gaps.acceptance_test: A closed then reopened ticket retains both episodes and correct first-human-response time, without double-counting a repeated handoff.

gaps.title: Separate resolution confirmation from satisfaction and silence
gaps.observed_state: Yes-resolved/No-need-help feedback exists only in unfinished local #241 changes, with metrics from a bounded recent sample. It is not deployed CSAT or all-traffic resolution reporting.
gaps.php_implementation: Keep explicit resolution confirmation; separately define satisfaction feedback and eligibility, display response rate/denominator and date range, and never assume silence means success.
gaps.acceptance_test: Unrated, escalated, negative, reopened and confirmed cases remain distinct; a small recent sample is never labeled a site-wide success rate.

gaps.title: Broaden retrieval tests and close the feedback-to-content loop
gaps.observed_state: Specific Ayyappa collection routing is fixed in #249/draft merge; generic and Tamil retrieval, no-match handling, source-versioned policies and failure-cluster review remain incomplete.
gaps.php_implementation: Use deterministic intent/source routing, multilingual aliases, actual collection membership, confidence/clarification rules and a human-reviewed queue of repeated failed topics. Promote resolved failures into golden fixtures.
gaps.acceptance_test: Ambiguous “festival products” requests clarification; Tamil/English variants match the same products; stale or missing policies are not fabricated.

gaps.title: Persist customer carts and safely merge guest carts
gaps.observed_state: CartService reads $_SESSION[cart]; no persisted cart lifecycle or cross-device customer-cart repository was found.
gaps.php_implementation: Use an authorized business cart record in existing MySQL infrastructure, with expiry/versioning and guest-to-account merge rules. Reprice and validate availability at checkout.
gaps.acceptance_test: Customer signs in on another device and recovers only their cart; guest merge handles duplicate items without stale prices or cross-account access.

gaps.title: Build a deduplicated end-to-end checkout funnel
gaps.observed_state: Uncommitted SiteTelemetryService only records cart_add and checkout_initiated. Paid orders are authoritative, but no complete attributed, deduplicated stage/error funnel exists.
gaps.php_implementation: Emit allowlisted events at real business boundaries: cart validated, checkout started, payment attempt/failure, verified order and fulfilment transitions. Use a privacy-safe checkout correlation ID and event idempotency; payment verification is server-authoritative.
gaps.acceptance_test: Gateway callback retry counts one purchase; failed checkout is not a successful stage; counts reconcile with paid-order records and clear denominators.

gaps.title: Measure abandoned carts from persistent state, not guessed event ratios
gaps.observed_state: Session-only cart data and two action counters cannot establish who abandoned a checkout or its recoverable value.
gaps.php_implementation: Define active/converted/expired carts and a documented abandonment window. Report cart age/value and recovery outcomes; do not assume Bagisto’s two-day cutoff fits this business. Recovery messages require a separately approved customer-contact policy.
gaps.acceptance_test: A completed or still-active cart is not labeled abandoned; rerunning the report yields stable cohort counts and totals.

gaps.title: Add true SKU variants only where the catalogue needs them
gaps.observed_state: The product schema exposes one price and stock_status per product; no variant SKU/option-specific inventory/pricing contract was found.
gaps.php_implementation: Represent size/material/colour variants with their own SKU, price, stock and images while retaining a parent product and backward-compatible existing slugs.
gaps.acceptance_test: Choosing a size changes the actual order-line SKU/price/availability; variant selection survives cart, checkout and invoice.

gaps.title: Track numeric saleable inventory and reservations
gaps.observed_state: Current stock_status and post-payment on_hold protection exist. There is no numeric stock movement/reservation/source ledger in the inspected product contract.
gaps.php_implementation: Add quantity accounting and atomic reservations/release before promising stock. Retain the existing on_hold safeguard. Multi-location inventory is optional unless needed; do not overbuild it first.
gaps.acceptance_test: Two simultaneous buyers cannot consume the same last item; cancellation/refund/restock changes quantities exactly once.

gaps.title: Support line-level partial shipment and remaining quantities
gaps.observed_state: Current fulfilment is primarily an order-level state and tracking fields. No shipment-line ledger with shipped/remaining quantities was found.
gaps.php_implementation: Introduce explicit shipment records with order-line quantities and tracking, validated against available quantities. Derive order-level status from the line ledger.
gaps.acceptance_test: Shipping one of two items leaves the other outstanding; a repeated shipment submission cannot overship or emit duplicate notifications.

gaps.title: Add returns and quantity-level refund allocation without replacing verified refunds
gaps.observed_state: Gateway-verified refunds, partial/full amount summaries and totals protection already exist. Missing: customer return requests, reasons/disposition and allocation to item quantities.
gaps.php_implementation: Keep provider verification as canonical. Add reviewed return/claim states and line/quantity allocations, inspect/replacement/refund decisions and stock disposition. Never infer payment success from customer text.
gaps.acceptance_test: A partial return cannot exceed purchased quantity or verified refund amount; duplicate imports remain idempotent and invoice history is preserved.

gaps.title: Extend promotion eligibility rather than rebuilding coupons
gaps.observed_state: Coupons already support fixed/percentage discounts, dates, spend limits, free shipping and usage rules. Product/category/customer-group rules and explicit stacking precedence are not modeled.
gaps.php_implementation: Add a small versioned eligibility rule contract for real marketing requirements, define conflict/stacking precedence, and derive applied promotions from saved order evidence.
gaps.acceptance_test: One coupon cannot discount excluded products; totals are reproducible at checkout and historical invoices keep their original price evidence.

gaps.title: Wishlist/save-for-later is optional backlog
gaps.observed_state: No customer-owned wishlist/save-for-later model or route was found in the inspected implementation. This is an optional feature opportunity, not a critical checkout defect.
gaps.php_implementation: Add customer-owned saved items only if requested. Validate price and availability again when moving an item to cart; do not assume optional paid extensions are part of the free reference.
gaps.acceptance_test: Saved items are account-isolated; unavailable products cannot silently become purchasable when moved to cart.

gaps.title: Connect successful current-head CI to review requests
gaps.observed_state: Main only contains branch PR creation and Validate application. There is no post-CI review coordinator; bapX/** branches were omitted from branch automation.
gaps.php_implementation: The accompanying repair adds a trusted-default-branch metadata-only workflow, exact-head validation, once-per-reviewer/commit request markers and bapX/** coverage.
gaps.acceptance_test: Failed/stale CI, foreign repository or changed head produces no request; no PR code executes with write tokens.

gaps.title: Respect reviewer-specific draft and author rules
gaps.observed_state: Five current PRs are drafts. CodeRabbit defaults exclude drafts unless configured; Sourcery documents that bot-authored comments are ignored.
gaps.php_implementation: Enable CodeRabbit draft/incremental review via validated configuration. Use native vendor settings or an explicitly configured dedicated real-user request token for post-CI comments; never substitute a GitHub Actions/App bot for Sourcery.
gaps.acceptance_test: A missing or bot-type token is reported blocked, not successful. Existing drafts are never marked ready just to force a review.

gaps.title: Detect quota failures and actual reviewer receipts
gaps.observed_state: Live manual request on #245 received Codex usage exhaustion. #240 has a completed current-head Codex receipt. Sourcery/CodeRabbit commands on #245 have no current-head receipt observed.
gaps.php_implementation: Classify requested, in-progress, completed-with-findings, quota-blocked and unknown separately. Bind receipts to current SHA and trusted bot identity; suppress blind quota retries.
gaps.acceptance_test: A quota comment or a posted request never counts as reviewed; old-head and human-forged Codex summaries are ignored.

gaps.title: Document external prerequisites without pretending code can provision them
gaps.observed_state: Current GitHub connection has push but not admin permissions; no dedicated reviewer request secret is configured. App entitlement/installation settings cannot be established from silence.
project_sources: GitHub repository permissions/variable and secret-name inventory
gaps.php_implementation: Document least-privilege REVIEW_REQUEST_TOKEN or native app configuration, default-branch activation requirement and quota recovery. Do not reuse unrelated secrets, buy credits or automatically merge.
gaps.acceptance_test: Tokenless audit explicitly lists blocked prerequisites; a workflow job success is described as an audit run, not provider approval.

delivery.project_ci: passed locally and GitHub current-head validate
delivery.external_gates: Codex review quota; native reviewer settings/entitlements; default-branch activation; optional dedicated user request token
